consequences: Missing carrier information should be repaired at the earliest justified producer boundary rather than guessed by a later consumer.
Evidence that carries different semantic roles must not share authority merely because it shares an edge kind or token field.
Consumer authority must be narrower than or equal to the evidence role actually carried by the representation.
Unknown, ambiguous, unsupported, or structurally incomplete evidence remains fail closed.
fundamental_research_invariant.statement: RISU Verify certifies whether consequential distinctions survive implementation. A repair may restore an already-supported semantic distinction to the representation or authority surface, but may not invent a distinction downstream merely to increase coverage.

extra negative-index structural edges do not change resolved operator
case IDs/language/truth are not inputs to repair decisions

roadmap_decision.reason_for_interlock: The immutable first Candidate58 challenge produced zero semantic selective coverage, and Gate2B diagnostics localized a dominant development-time substrate failure. Running Mutation Algebra on the known-defective substrate would risk measuring abstention artifacts rather than the consequence semantics the algebra is intended to characterize.

COMPARISON_OPERATOR_AUTHORITY.authority: Only COMPARES evidence tied to canonical comparison operand positions may contribute comparator semantics. Structural-control COMPARES evidence is non-authoritative for EQ/NE operator resolution.
COMPARISON_OPERATOR_AUTHORITY.failure_policy: missing expected operand evidence, unsupported authoritative token, nonunique token cardinality, or normalized disagreement remains unresolved
COMPARISON_OPERATOR_AUTHORITY.structural_control_rule: negative operand_index is structural/control evidence and must never be normalized as a comparison operator
COMPARISON_OPERATOR_AUTHORITY.token_rule: every authoritative comparison-operand edge must carry exactly one token in the frozen supported EQ/NE vocabulary; all authoritative rows must agree

CONTROL_MEMBERSHIP_AUTHORITY.authority: CONTROL_CONDITION / CONTROL_PREDICATE_RESULT may evidence control membership or predicate flow only
CONTROL_MEMBERSHIP_AUTHORITY.prohibition: these sentinels may not be added to the EQ/NE comparison normalization vocabulary

GUARD_SCOPE_PROVENANCE.authority: The GUARD_COMPARISON anchor may carry scope only when its frozen structured-control provenance resolves exactly one containing function/control scope.
GUARD_SCOPE_PROVENANCE.failure_policy: if unique structured scope is not established, scope remains absent and downstream semantics remain incomplete
non_authority: downstream adapter reconstruction from unrelated names
GUARD_SCOPE_PROVENANCE.required_representation_property: scope is explicit on the provenance-bearing GUARD_COMPARISON anchor before adapter consumption
